entries.proposition: The paper's one statement about metabolism is a sentence citing a review and the Choo 2015 respiratory-complex primary; no respiration, glucose or lipid readout is measured here.
entries.snippet: In addition, WWOX is involved in mitochondrial respiration and metabolism (45, 46).

entries.proposition: The mitochondrial presence of WWOX, IkappaB-alpha and ERK in MOLT-4 cells rests on a cytoplasmic and mitochondrial fractionation blot and on confocal co-localisation with a mitochondrial dye.
entries.snippet: We then isolated the cytoplasmic and mitochondrial fractions from MOLT-4. WWOX, IκBα, and ERK were present in the cytoplasm and mitochondria (Fig. 4C).
entries.anchor: Results, WWOX Bound IkappaB-alpha and ERK in the Mitochondria

entries.proposition: TNF does not release WWOX from mitochondria in this assay, while ionophore plus PMA does, so the mitochondrial pool is not simply a stress-release pool.
entries.snippet: In comparison, TNF-α did not effectively reduce the levels of WWOX in the mitochondria (Fig. 4E).

entries.snippet: In our preliminary study, we made Ser-14-phosphorylated and non-phosphorylated WWOX peptides of 15 amino acid residues and found that the phosphorylated peptide is a potent inducer of T cell expansion in BALB/c mice growing with melanoma.
